hq_location.notes: The company identifies its headquarters in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.

public_docs.notes: The public Help Center contains multiple product support articles and sections, including technical-reference content.

raised_18mo.notes: The reported $10.7 million round occurred in June 2025, within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026.

founded_year.notes: Neostella states it was founded in 2019.

last_funding.notes: Funding sources report a $10.7 million venture round in June 2025; PitchBook gives June 5, 2025 as the date, while Crunchbase categorizes it as Venture – Series Unknown.

launched_6mo.notes: On May 11, 2026, Neostella wrote that it introduced a new connected case-management approach and multiple platform capabilities at NeoSummit; this is within the six-month window.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists platform pricing and pricing options.

employee_band.notes: Neostella’s about page says it has 250+ employees; LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The currently surfaced openings on Neostella’s Workable board do not include SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive roles.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed public help articles, blog, and security/trust information do not identify the model provider used by Neostella’s product. References to external AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT concern integrations, not a stated underlying provider.

named_customers.notes: The closest customer evidence names Central States Funds; another customer story describes a veteran’s disability firm without naming it. Fewer than two customer names are publicly identified on these reviewed pages.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current Neostella Workable postings surfaced include roles such as DevOps Engineer, Product Support Specialist, Marketing Generalist, and Implementation Support Specialist, with no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

compliance_certs.notes: Neostella’s announcement says it achieved SOC 2 Type II certification.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The integrations page describes integration categories but does not name external CRM or sales/marketing systems. Neostella’s own Intake CRM is a product feature, not a named third-party stack system.

product_one_liner.notes: The company describes the platform as enterprise legal case-management software for modern legal teams.
product_one_liner.value: Neostella provides connected legal case-management software that brings case, document, workflow, communication, and reporting tools together for law firms and legal teams.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The complete team page lists its leadership; the dated leadership announcements and profile surfaced in research place the identified C-level promotions or changes before November 9, 2025, not in the 12-month window.
